headline: Zymeworks Unveils Trial Results for Ovarian Cancer Drug ZW191
summary: Biotechnology firm Zymeworks presented clinical trial results evaluating its experimental therapy ZW191 for patients with ovarian cancer.
why: Clinical oncology trial results are primary valuation drivers for clinical-stage biotechnology companies seeking pipeline validation and commercialization.

impacts.name: Zymeworks Inc
impacts.why: Biotech market valuations react immediately to patient response and safety data reported in cancer clinical trials.
